name: Bronze Armor
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: The paint was released on September 3rd, 2021.
The paint was added to ultra containers for the Tankers day celebrations in 2021. They were added along with the newly released steampunk skins for Twins and Mammoth.
